en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a courtyard with a tall, slender Ottoman-style minaret rising behind surrounding buildings and trees. In the foreground a person stands in an open space between stucco houses. The architecture is European with a distinct Islamic minaret attached to (or immediately behind) a chapel-like building. Printed Hungarian text along the bottom identifies the location.
